mantras.title: Oṃ — the primordial sound
mantras.meaning: The sacred syllable of the Upaniṣads and the Yoga Sūtra (1.27: ‘its expression is the sacred syllable’). Chanted softly, it is simply a long, gentle out-breath that ends in a hum.

mantras.title: Gāyatrī mantra
mantras.deva:
ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः ।
तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि ।
धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
mantras.iast:
oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ |
tat savitur vareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi |
dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
mantras.meaning: We meditate on the radiant light of the divine Sun (Savitṛ); may it inspire and brighten our minds.
mantras.note: Some families follow initiation customs for this mantra; please follow yours. Listening, or choosing another prayer, is equally welcome.
mantras.alt: Read a short poem or prayer you love, slowly, three times.

mantras.title: Saha nāvavatu — together
mantras.deva:
ॐ सह नाववतु । सह नौ भुनक्तु ।
सह वीर्यं करवावहै ।
तेजस्वि नावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
mantras.iast:
oṃ saha nāv avatu | saha nau bhunaktu |
saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai |
tejasvi nāv adhītam astu mā vidviṣāvahai ||
oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
mantras.meaning: May we two be protected together; may we be nourished together; may we grow strong together; may our learning shine; may there be no ill-will between us. Peace, peace, peace. — Traditionally said by teacher and student; here, by mother and baby: ‘we two’.
mantras.alt: Say: ‘May we two be safe. May we two be well. May we grow together.’

mantras.title: Asato mā — towards light
mantras.deva:
असतो मा सद्गमय ।
तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय ।
मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय ॥
mantras.iast:
asato mā sad gamaya |
tamaso mā jyotir gamaya |
mṛtyor mā amṛtaṃ gamaya ||
mantras.meaning: Lead me from the unreal to the real; from darkness to light; from death to immortality.
mantras.alt: Say: ‘May I move from worry to trust, from darkness to light.’

mantras.title: Pūrṇamadaḥ — fullness
mantras.deva:
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते ।
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते ॥
mantras.iast:
oṃ pūrṇam adaḥ pūrṇam idaṃ pūrṇāt pūrṇam udacyate |
pūrṇasya pūrṇam ādāya pūrṇam evāvaśiṣyate ||
mantras.meaning: That is whole; this is whole. From wholeness, wholeness comes forth. When wholeness is taken from wholeness, wholeness remains. — A beautiful image for a mother: a whole new life comes from you, and you remain whole.
mantras.alt: Say: ‘I am whole. You are whole. Love only grows.’

mantras.title: Sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ — for all
mantras.deva:
सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः । सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः ।
सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु । मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत् ॥
mantras.iast:
sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ | sarve santu nirāmayāḥ |
sarve bhadrāṇi paśyantu | mā kaścid duḥkhabhāg bhavet ||
mantras.meaning: May all be happy; may all be free from illness; may all see what is good; may no one suffer.
mantras.source: Traditional prayer (often attributed to the Upaniṣads; a close parallel appears in the Garuḍa Purāṇa) [needs verification]
mantras.alt: Say: ‘May everyone be happy and healthy.’

mantras.title: Madālasā’s lullaby
mantras.meaning: You are pure, you are awake, you are spotless; you are untouched by the world’s illusion. — Sung by Queen Madālasā to her infant sons in the Purāṇic story.
mantras.source: Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa (Madālasā episode); Madālasā Upadeśa tradition [wording needs verification]
mantras.alt: Sing: ‘You are whole, you are good, you are loved.’

lullabies.native:
स्वपिहि वत्स स्वपिहि, चन्द्रो गगने हसति ।
माता त्वां पालयति, शान्तिः सर्वत्र भवतु ॥
lullabies.roman:
svapihi vatsa svapihi, candro gagane hasati |
mātā tvāṃ pālayati, śāntiḥ sarvatra bhavatu ||
lullabies.meaning: Sleep, little one, sleep; the moon smiles in the sky. Mother watches over you; may there be peace everywhere.

lullabies.native:
सो जा मेरे चंदा, सो जा मेरे लाल,
तारे गाएँ लोरी, हवा दे ताल।
माँ की बाँहों में सपनों का गाँव,
धीरे-धीरे आए निंदिया की छाँव।
lullabies.roman:
so jā mere candā, so jā mere lāl,
tāre gāẽ lorī, havā de tāl.
mā̃ kī bā̃hõ mẽ sapnõ kā gā̃v,
dhīre-dhīre āe nindiyā kī chā̃v.
lullabies.meaning: Sleep, my moon, sleep, my darling; the stars sing a lullaby, the breeze keeps time. In mother’s arms is a village of dreams; slowly comes the shade of sleep.

lullabies.native:
झोप रे बाळा झोप, चांदोबा आला अंगणी,
हळू हळू झुलतो पाळणा, गाते आई गाणी।
lullabies.roman:
jhop re bāḷā jhop, cāndobā ālā aṅgaṇī,
haḷū haḷū jhulato pāḷaṇā, gāte āī gāṇī.
lullabies.meaning: Sleep, little one, sleep; Uncle Moon has come to the courtyard. Slowly the cradle swings; mother sings her songs.

lullabies.native:
હાલા રે હાલા, સૂઈ જા મારા લાલ,
ચાંદામામા જુએ, તારલા ગાય ગીત.
lullabies.roman:
hālā re hālā, sūī jā mārā lāl,
cāndāmāmā jue, tāralā gāya gīt.
lullabies.meaning: Hush-a-bye, hush-a-bye, sleep my darling; Uncle Moon is watching, the little stars sing a song.

lullabies.native:
ஆராரோ ஆரிரரோ, கண்ணே கண்மணியே கண்ணுறங்கு,
நிலா வந்து தாலாட்டும், நீ நிம்மதியாய் தூங்கு.
lullabies.roman:
ārārō ārirarō, kaṇṇē kaṇmaṇiyē kaṇṇuṟaṅku,
nilā vantu tālāṭṭum, nī nimmatiyāy tūṅku.
lullabies.meaning: Aa-raa-ro, aa-ri-ra-ro (traditional refrain); my darling, apple of my eye, close your eyes; the moon will come and sing you a lullaby — sleep in peace.

lullabies.native:
జో అచ్యుతానంద జో జో ముకుంద,
రావె పరమానంద రామ గోవింద.
lullabies.roman:
jō acyutānanda jō jō mukunda,
rāve paramānanda rāma gōvinda.
lullabies.meaning: Sleep, Achyuta, bliss; sleep, sleep, Mukunda; come, supreme joy, Rāma, Govinda. — A cradle song to the infant Krishna.

lullabies.native:
ಜೋ ಜೋ ಶ್ರೀ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಪರಮಾನಂದ,
ಜೋ ಜೋ ಗೋಪಿಯ ಕಂದ ಮುಕುಂದ.
lullabies.roman:
jō jō śrī kṛṣṇa paramānanda,
jō jō gōpiya kanda mukunda.
lullabies.meaning: Sleep, sleep, Shri Krishna, supreme bliss; sleep, sleep, darling of the gopī, Mukunda.
lullabies.credit: Purandara Dāsa (1484–1564), public domain [wording needs verification]

lullabies.native:
ഓമനത്തിങ്കൾ കിടാവോ, നല്ല
കോമളത്താമരപ്പൂവോ,
പൂവിൽ നിറഞ്ഞ മധുവോ, പരി-
പൂർണ്ണേന്ദു തന്റെ നിലാവോ.
lullabies.roman:
ōmanattiṅkaḷ kiṭāvō, nalla
kōmaḷattāmarappūvō,
pūvil niṟañña madhuvō, pari-
pūrṇēndu tanṟe nilāvō.
lullabies.meaning: Are you the darling child of the moon, or a lovely tender lotus? The honey filling a flower, or the light of the full moon?

lullabies.native:
ঘুমপাড়ানি মাসি পিসি মোদের বাড়ি এসো,
খাট নেই পালঙ্ক নেই চোখ পেতে বোসো।
lullabies.roman:
ghumpāṛāni māsi pisi moder bāṛi eso,
khāṭ nei pālaṅka nei cokh pete boso.
lullabies.meaning: Sleep-bringing aunties, come to our house; there’s no bed or cot — sit upon our eyes. (Calling sleep to come to the child.)
lullabies.credit: Traditional chhaṛā, public domain [wording needs verification]

ys1.2.meaning: Yoga is the settling of the mind’s ripples.

ys1.12.meaning: Steady practice and gentle letting go calm the mind.

ys1.33.meaning: Friendliness, compassion, gladness and equanimity make the mind clear and serene.

ys2.33.meaning: When troubling thoughts arise, cultivate their opposite.

ys2.46.meaning: Posture should be steady and comfortable.

gita2.48.meaning: Evenness of mind is called yoga.

amrita2.meaning: The mind alone is the cause of our bondage and our freedom.
